mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, difficulty, status, current_interview_question_id, planned_question_count, completed_question_count, total_score, report_status, version, started_at, ended_at, created_at, updated_at FROM interview_session WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE interview_session SET current_interview_question_id = NULL, completed_question_count = completed_question_count + 1, status = 'COMPLETED', ended_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{expectedVersion} AND status = 'IN_PROGRESS' AND current_interview_question_id = #{expectedCurrentQuestionId} AND completed_question_count < planned_question_count
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, difficulty, status, current_interview_question_id, planned_question_count, completed_question_count, total_score, report_status, version, started_at, ended_at, created_at, updated_at FROM interview_session WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status IN('CREATED','IN_PROGRESS') ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO interview_session( user_id, difficulty, status, current_interview_question_id, planned_question_count, completed_question_count, total_score, report_status, version, started_at, ended_at ) VALUES( #{userId}, #{difficulty}, #{status}, #{currentInterviewQuestionId}, #{plannedQuestionCount}, #{completedQuestionCount}, #{totalScore}, #{reportStatus}, #{version}, #{startedAt}, #{endedAt} )
mapper.update: UPDATE interview_session SET status = 'IN_PROGRESS', current_interview_question_id = #{firstQuestionId}, started_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{expectedVersion} AND status = 'CREATED' AND current_interview_question_id IS NULL

UPDATE interview_session SET report_status = 'READY', total_score = #{totalScore}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{expectedVersion} AND status = 'COMPLETED' AND report_status = 'GENERATING'
UPDATE interview_session SET report_status = 'FAILED', version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{expectedVersion} AND status = 'COMPLETED' AND report_status = 'GENERATING'
